description: Express.js route module for session tracking API, including caching, tenant handling, and CRUD operations.

methods.name: roundToMinuteISO
methods.description: Converts a string date to ISO format rounded to the nearest minute.

methods.name: cacheKeyFromReq
methods.description: Generates a cache key string based on request query parameters and enforced tenant.

methods.name: cacheSet
methods.description: Stores response in cache with an ETag.

methods.name: invalidateAllSessionTrackingCache
methods.description: Clears all session tracking related cache entries.

methods.name: computeETag
methods.description: Computes an ETag hash based on payload and context for cache validation.

methods.name: sessionsEarlyBypassDetector
methods.description: Middleware to detect early bypass conditions based on headers and query parameters.
